en: A live status indicator now appears below the last message. It uses available execution signals to distinguish working, thinking, tools, replies and confirmation, and clearly marks stopping, stopped, failed and ended turns.

The round send arrow becomes a stop button while the selected task runs. Pending stop requests prevent duplicate clicks; drafts can still be steered or queued. No voice controls are added. Motion respects reduced-motion preferences.
zh: 最后一条消息下方新增实时状态，依据执行信号区分处理、思考、工具调用、回复和等待确认，并明确标记正在停止、已停止、执行未完成和本轮结束。
圆形发送箭头在当前任务运行时切换为停止按钮；停止处理中防止重复点击，追加内容仍可引导或排队。不加入语音控件，并适配减少动态效果的偏好。
